title: feat(lint): os validate judges every keyed child of an action translation entry against its declaration
body:
Fixes #21216
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

`validateTranslationReferences` (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`) is the rule behind `translation-target-unknown`, and `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint` all run it. It now judges every keyed child of an action's translation entry against what the action declares. Both addresses are covered: `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION` and `globalActions.ACTION`. Before this change the walk (`checkActionParams`) judged `params.NAME` and nothing else.

| bundle key | judged against | code · level | the runtime read it mirrors |
|---|---|---|---|
| `params.NAME` | `params[].name`, falling back to `field` | `translation-target-unknown` · error (unchanged) | `translateActionParams` |
| `outcomeMessages.OUTCOME` | the keys of the action's `outcomeMessages` | `translation-target-unknown` · error (**new**) | `resolveActionOutcomeMessages` |
| `resultDialog.fields.PATH` | each literal `resultDialog.fields[].path` | `translation-target-unknown` · error (**new**) | `resolveActionResultDialog`, and objectui's `actionResultDialog` |
| `params.NAME.options.VALUE` | a declared param's inline `options[].value` | `translation-option-key-unknown` · warning (**new**) | `translateActionParams`, and objectui's `actionParamOptionLabel` |

- **No second vocabulary.** Undeclared outcomes and result-field paths reuse `params`' own code and severity. Option keys reuse the code and severity a field's `options` key already gets (`checkOptionKeys`), including the "keyed by the display label, rename it to the value" diagnosis. The module's Severity note explains why option keys stay warnings: such a key names something real, and the fix is a rename.
- **Where the declared sets come from (runtime read sites, on `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`):**
  - `resolveActionOutcomeMessages` loops over `Object.keys(action.outcomeMessages)`. When the action declares no `outcomeMessages`, it returns `undefined` before reading any bundle key. So for such an action every bundle outcome is unread, and the lint refuses each one.
  - `resolveActionResultDialog` maps over the declared `fields[]` and looks up `fields[field.path]`. With no `resultDialog` it reads nothing. With a dialog that declares no `fields`, it reads no label. objectui's `useObjectLabel.actionResultDialog` uses the same keys.
  - Param options are judged only against an **inline** `options` array. The spec resolver overlays only that array. objectui resolves `param.options` first and falls back to the referenced field's options, so an authored array wins. A field-backed param with no inline array gets its list from the field when the dialog renders. This rule does not re-derive that inheritance, so those keys are deliberately left unjudged.
- A result-field path is one literal key, dots included, so the finding's config path brackets it: `resultDialog.fields["client.ghost"]`. `localePath` now uses the same `memberPath` helper, and its output is byte-identical.
- **Coverage pin.** The test file gets a twin of the object-branch coverage pin. It reads the action translation shape off `ObjectTranslationDataSchema` and `TranslationDataSchema` (both addresses), down into `params.NAME.*` and `resultDialog.*`, and holds that key set equal to a classification ledger. Every `reference-checked` key needs a ghost that reports at both addresses. When the next keyed group joins the shape with no leg, this pin fails. That gap is how `outcomeMessages` shipped unjudged.

## Measured at the public door (`os validate --json`)

The probe stack is a `defineStack` app with `delete_probe` (bound, declares outcome `archived`, params `reason`, and `mode` with inline option `fast`), `reveal_probe` (bound, `resultDialog.fields[].path` = `client.secret`), `check_probe` (object-less, outcome `up_to_date`) and `reveal_global` (object-less, path `token`). Its `zh-CN` bundle carries each declared key and one undeclared sibling. The CLI closure was built at each tree.

| key in the bundle | before, `be5a83cf` (clean `main`) | after, `ac847edd` / `dd39cf54` |
|---|---|---|
| `_actions.reveal_probe.resultDialog.fields["client.ghost"]` | no finding | `translation-target-unknown` error |
| `globalActions.reveal_global.resultDialog.fields.ghost_token` | no finding | `translation-target-unknown` error |
| `_actions.delete_probe.outcomeMessages.restored` | no finding | `translation-target-unknown` error |
| `globalActions.check_probe.outcomeMessages.stale` | no finding | `translation-target-unknown` error |
| `_actions.delete_probe.params.mode.options.slow` | no finding | `translation-option-key-unknown` warning |
| `_actions.delete_probe.params.not_a_param` (control: the door is reached) | `translation-target-unknown` error | unchanged |
| declared `archived`, `up_to_date`, `client.secret`, `token`, `fast`, `reason` (controls) | no finding | no finding |

## Consumers whose verdict could move (direction: downstream of `@objectstack/lint`)

- `os validate --json` over the four example apps, after the change: `app-crm` exit 0, `app-todo` exit 0, `app-showcase` exit 0, `app-multi-package` exit 0. Each has **0** findings on an `outcomeMessages`, `resultDialog.fields` or `params.NAME.options` path, and 0 translation-rule findings at all. These legs judged nothing before this change, so any finding on those paths would have been new.
- The bundle `@objectstack/platform-objects` ships (`SetupAppTranslations`: 4 locales, 50 objects) was run through the rule. It carries 64 `resultDialog.fields` keys and 44 param-option keys, and none of them is flagged. It carries 0 outcome keys. Docs and `skills/**` hold no translation bundle with these keys. No published bundle needed a fix.

## Tests

All runs are at `ac847edd`. The lint source in `dd39cf54` is byte-identical; that commit adds only the changeset.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 119 files / **5517 passed**.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. The test-layer ledger holds 2 files / 6 errors, unchanged.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`, at `dd39cf54`, in two shards: 122 files / 1861 passed, then 121 files / 1578 passed. The `integration` tier is left to CI, because no integration-tier file or spawn entry is touched.
- New in `validate-translation-references.test.ts`: 15 cases. An undeclared outcome is refused at `_actions.ACTION` and at `globalActions.ACTION`. Declared outcomes pass at both addresses (the control). An action with no `outcomeMessages` has every outcome refused. The same three shapes cover `resultDialog.fields`, including the bracketed dotted path. Param options cover a value miss, a label key, a param with neither options nor field, the field-backed skip, and an undeclared param reported once. The coverage pin adds 3 cases.

**Reverse verification** (committed first, then mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, with a restore trap; every restore was proven by blob hash equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`):
- Leg A drops the `outcomeMessages` and `resultDialog.fields` calls: **7 failed** / 142 passed. Those are the 6 refusal cases plus the coverage pin's "backs every reference-checked claim". The 2 control cases stay green.
- Leg B disables the param-options call: **3 failed** / 146 passed. Those are the 2 option warnings plus the coverage pin.
- The direction is turned red, as expected. The suite reads `src` through a relative import, so no `dist/` leg applies. The door probe's `@objectstack/lint` dist was checked with `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/lint checkActionResultDialogFields`: the marker is present in 4 built files and the tree is clean.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 60 families from the merge base `be5a83cf`, and all 60 were run at `dd39cf54`. `--ran` reports **60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**, and every exit is 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 8 unrelated packages had no `dist/`). After a turbo build of those 8, it was re-run and exited 0. The derivation flagged a stale tree: `origin/main` is 4 commits ahead, and `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` and `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` changed upstream. Neither family reads the files this PR edits. The 6 value-bearing CI-only invocations (shard attestation, test completeness, `check-issue-citations --census`) are NOT MEASURED here because they are CI-only.

ESLint was narrowed to the two edited files. Their population comes from eslint's own config: `--print-config` resolves a config for each. The JSON output reports 2 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. Type-aware linting is not enabled (`eslint.config.mjs` sets no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

Both of these were measured at the door with a second probe and reported to the PM rather than fixed here.
- A bound action's `globalActions.ACTION` key is refused with "This key is never read". `translateAction` (via `lookupActionField`) and objectui's `actionSuffixes` both fall back to `globalActions.ACTION` for a bound action, and that probe's label resolves. So the lint's message and the resolvers disagree, and this PR touches neither side.
- `_actions.ACTION.resultDialog.title`, `.description` and `.acknowledge` on an action that declares no `resultDialog` pass silently, and nothing reads them. These are leaf copy on an undeclared node, not a keyed child, so the coverage pin classifies `resultDialog` as a container and this PR leaves them unjudged.
